title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on When the Final Judgment and Ruling in a Criminal Case Become Legally Effective

articles.content_en:
July 26, 2004
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Issue of When a Final Judgment or Order
of a Criminal Case Becomes Legally Effective
Interpretation No. 7 [2004] of the Supreme People's Court
To the Higher People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:
Recently, some courts have reported that the issue of when a final judgment or order of a criminal case becomes legally effective is unclear. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
In accordance with the spirit of the provisions of Articles 163, 195, and 208 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, a final judgment or order shall become legally effective from the date of its pronouncement.
It is hereby replied.
